articles.summary: BitGo Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: BTGO) (“BitGo”), the digital asset infrastructure company, today announced BitGo has taken a strategic position in APT, the native token of Aptos network. The move builds on BitGo's existing support for institutions operating in Aptos, including custody for APT and assets built on the Aptos Digital Asset Standard, APT staking, and self-custody wallet connectivity to Decibel, a decentralized exchange (DEX) built on Aptos. BitGo’s work with Aptos spans custody, staking, and access to onchain markets. Eligible clients can custody and stake APT through BitGo. Institutional clients using BitGo self-custody wallets can also elect to connect to Decibel through their existing wallet approval workflows. “Institutional adoption tends to follow solid infrastructure,” said Michael Ching, Head of Treasury and Operations at Aptos Foundation. “BitGo has been building on Aptos for some time, and we’re excited to see that commitment continue to grow. (NYSE: BTGO) (“BitGo” or “the Company”), the digital asset infrastructure company, today reported its financial results for its third quarter ended September 30, 2026. Completed the acquisition of NYDIG’s institutional trading business, expanding BitGo’s capabilities in derivatives, structured products, and financing and broadening institutional client relationships. Expanded institutional trading and settlement connectivity, extending the OKX off-exchange settlement integration internationally and introducing BitGo Prime’s Global Liquidity Layer. Net income of $44.1 million driven by the appreciation of BitGo’s digital asset treasury since Q2’26. articles.summary: A full-service institutional markets offering, backed by an experienced capital markets team and BitGo's digital asset infrastructure BitGo Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: BTGO) (“BitGo” or “Company”), the digital asset infrastructure company, today announced the launch of BitGo Global Markets, its institutional trading and financial solutions business bringing together global liquidity, execution, financing, derivatives, and settlement capabilities. Global Markets combines BitGo’s established institutional trading business and Prime Services offering with expanded derivatives, collateral management, and structured finance expertise. Supported by BitGo’s digital asset infrastructure, the business serves institutions seeking to trade at scale, access capital, and take a more deliberate approach to managing their digital asset exposure.
